crossRefs.note: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
translations.bsb: Then Balaam said, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
translations.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
translations.asv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
